audit_items.proof_trace: The invariant depends on BPO entries having ForkVersion correctly inherited during prepare(). If prepare() fails (line 400 only logs error, doesn't abort), BPO entries retain zero-value ForkVersion [0,0,0,0], which updateENR() would advertise as next_fork_version instead of current_fork_version, violating the invariant.
audit_items.attack_scenario: Trigger prepare() failure via malformed GenesisValidatorsRoot or fork digest computation error. When forkWatcher() calls updateENR() with unprepared BPO entry, ENR advertises next_fork_version=[0,0,0,0] instead of current fork version, causing peer disconnections and network fragmentation.
